assumptions: THIS IS NOT A DERIVATION OF `allowed_subjects`. Nothing here establishes that authority_mutation reaches only authority.
It refuses SILENT growth. A widening declared out loud still passes, and should — the record then says which rows are constrained by nothing.
attrs.evidence: GPT-5.6 attacked exactly where R7.2's own brief said the trust had moved. It widened authority_mutation.allowed_subjects from ["authority"] to ["authority","lineage"] and reported the gate still green. Reproduced here before the fix, and the reproduction is sharper than the report: `node scripts/emb-battery-control.mjs` exits 0, and the only refusal anywhere in the four-gate set is a receipt DIGEST MISMATCH on mosaic/embodiment.json — a tamper detector that every legitimate round dissolves by refreshing the digest, which is the MUT-HIST-REVISION-SWAP lesson from R6.1. So nothing semantic refused it. The cause is that NO MEMBER USES THAT PAIRING, and an unexercised row is constrained by nothing. The fix does not guess at wrong pairs, which is the mutation whack-a-mole this lane has been learning to avoid; it requires every row to be exercised or declared, which turns the unconstrained surface into a number in the output — R6's discipline of relocating doubt from prose into the count. Two registered mutations, refused on every invocation: GPT-5.6's widening, and its inverse, silencing a row a member does exercise. THE RULE FOUND A LIVE ROW ON ITS FIRST RUN, before any auditor did: support_ablation::support_realization is declared reachable and exercised by nothing, because R7.1 added support_realization to the conservation matrix and the ten members were written against capability and evidence.
attrs.prior_art: GPT-5.6's audit of INV-R7.2, item 5 — including its instruction NOT to close this syntactically, which is followed: the semantic claim stays open and is carried by MOS-DERIVED-SUBJECT's review_focus.

readjudicated.note: The source-lane status is recorded in imported_from.source_status as provenance. This field records that the TARGET lane re-established it; the two are separate facts and the gate reads this one.

attrs.review_focus: The residual is exactly what GPT-5.6 said it was. `allowed_subjects` is an intervention effect contract, and closing it needs the intervention to be executable and its declared non-effects tested against the implementation. Until then a row is DECLARED, and this rule only makes sure a declaration is what it is.
attrs.statement: Every declared (intervention, subject quantity) row must be exercised by a battery member or declared unexercised with a reason, so the relation cannot grow surface that nothing constrains.
